title: Classification into Groups, Periods and Blocks
topicTitle: Classification of elements into different groups, periods and blocks
notes: **Groups:** vertical columns. 18 groups numbered 1-18. Elements in a group have similar valence electron configurations and therefore similar chemistry.
**Periods:** horizontal rows. 7 periods. Period 1 has 2 elements; periods 2 and 3 have 8 each; periods 4 and 5 have 18 each; periods 6 and 7 have 32 each.
**s-block:** Groups 1-2. Valence electrons in s-orbital. Highly reactive metals. ns$^{1-2}$ configuration.
**p-block:** Groups 13-18. Valence electrons in p-orbitals. Contains metals, metalloids and non-metals. ns$^2$np$^{1-6}$ configuration.
**d-block:** Groups 3-12. Transition metals. Valence electrons in d-orbitals. Hard, high-melting, coloured compounds, catalytic activity. $(n-1)d^{1-10}$ns$^{0-2}$ configuration.
